_comment: Extracted from the workflow so it is data rather than shell string-building:
tests/test_nix_distribution_policy.py reads this file to assert that the
platform support advertised in docs/NIX.md and README.md matches the systems
CI actually builds, smoke-launches, and pushes to Cachix. Any flake system
absent from every list here is unverified and must be documented best-effort.
Adding a system here without adding a docs row (or vice versa) fails that test.
